audit.whatIsWrong: Three things were absent. Purgatory grounds and Unstoppable Force is a dash — your R can cancel his engage rather than merely follow it. Granite Shield's actual size and recharge rule (absorbs up to 10% max health, recharges when he has not been hit for a few seconds) was never stated despite the page telling you to poke him. And the page says his armour blunts your burst without noting that Locke's W deals true damage, which armour does nothing against.
audit.why: All three change what the reader does: hold R for his leap, break the shield before committing rather than letting it recharge, and keep W in the combo precisely because he stacks armour.
